info.title: Zeceipt payout console API
info.description: The console's HTTP API as built so far (walking skeleton, slices C2 and D1). Loopback-only until authentication exists: every operation can answer 403 (problem+json) from the request guard; every request needs a loopback Host (localhost, *.localhost, 127.0.0.1, [::1]); unsafe methods are refused when Sec-Fetch-Site is cross-site or same-site, or when Origin is present and is not this host's own origin. Errors are RFC 9457 problem details (application/problem+json) with an extension member `code`.

get.summary: Liveness of the console and its database (IETF health+json)
Batches of this deployment's org, newest first

post.summary: Create a draft batch (moves no money). Not idempotent: a retry creates a second draft.

422.description: batch_invalid with every problem (code, index, detail), including memo_taken (the memo is already used by another batch of the org: a memo is a payable reference, unique in the org) and payable_reserved (the line carries a payable's id or reference: payables are paid only through POST /api/batches/from-payables); memo_invisible (slice H7): the memo holds invisible characters (Unicode Default_Ignorable_Code_Point, control characters, the braille blank) or a space other than U+0020

post.summary: Pay the batch once through the wallet (hot custody). Idempotent per batch: the nonce batch/<id> is the key; a retry returns the recorded txid with Idempotent-Replayed: true. Every problem states `thisRequest` (sent_nothing or may_have_sent) and links `batchStatus`. A client disconnect does not abort a payment in progress. Every attempt that will pay requires a valid approval of the batch as it is now, at its current lock (409 not_approved, sent_nothing; POST /api/batches/{id}/approve), and a rate lock and re-quotes the ZEC/USD rate: a fresh batch, a retry after a refusal, and a re-send of an attempt proven unminable. A move beyond ZECEIPT_RATE_MAX_DRIFT_BPS (default 300 bp) refuses with 409 rate_moved, no lock gives 409 rate_not_locked, and a failing source gives 502 rate_unavailable. All of these send nothing, and after a refusal the batch can be re-locked (then approved again). A retry that may already have paid (a replay of a broadcast, or a reconciliation that finds the payment) is never re-judged.

Idempotent-Replayed.description: Present when no new payment was made

409.description: payment_rejected, submission_in_flight (with Retry-After: 5; an attempt counts as running for up to 10 minutes), nonce_conflict, custody_external; batch_voided: the batch is voided (slice H5c), so it can never be paid (sent_nothing); not_approved: no valid approval of the batch as it is now at its current lock (a re-lock or any change to a line needs a new one; sent_nothing); already_paid_ambiguous: two or more mined transactions of the account already pay every line of this batch (slice S5: the wallet's history is read before every payment), so nothing was paid and a person decides (sent_nothing)

post.summary: Approve the batch as it is now (slice I3; REQ-CON-5 with one approver). The body names what the approver saw: the total and the current lock's seq. The approval is an HMAC-SHA256, under a key derived from the wrap key (HKDF, its own info), over the batch's lines (index, payable id, address, zat, memo), its network, the paying wallet account and the lock (seq, rate). It is valid only while all of them are unchanged: a re-lock or any change to a line needs a new approval. Every attempt that will pay requires one. Hot custody only.

lockSeq.description: Must be the current lock's seq (GET /api/batches/{id} rateLock.seq)

200.description: Already approved as it is now at this lock: the existing approval; nothing new recorded

approver.description: 'operator' (one approver; the console has no sign-in yet)
'operator' (one approver; the console has no sign-in yet)

409.description: custody_external; batch_voided; batch_frozen: a submission may have paid; rate_not_locked: lock first; approval_stale: the posted lockSeq is not the current lock (re-locked since; the extension `lockSeq` is the current one). Nothing was approved

422.description: confirmation_mismatch: confirmTotalZat is not the batch total; nothing was approved

get.summary: The batch's derived status (never stored): draft, approved, submitting, retryable, needs_attention, pending, confirming, confirmed, receipts_partial, receipts_issued, expired or voided, with the next action

detail.description: txid, confirmations, required, receipts, items, error, expiresBy, cause, stale. `error` is the wallet's own recorded reason (e.g. 'Not enough funds…'): operator data, render it as plain text, never as HTML.

get.summary: The batch's audit trail, oldest first (slice I4): one event per change, written by database triggers in the same transaction as the change, so no write path can skip it. No actor is recorded (one operator, no sign-in). Refusals that change nothing leave no event.

at.description: ISO 8601 UTC: the time the change's own record carries

action.description: created, locked, quoted (the execution quote), approved, attempt_submitting, attempt_broadcast, attempt_failed_retryable, attempt_unknown_outcome, expiry_recorded, voided, receipt_issued

detail.description: Non-secret fields of the change (seq, rate, source, lockSeq, approver, attempts, state, txid, error, expiresBy, idx, pool, outputIndex, valueZat, title, network); `backfilled: true` for events recorded by migration 0021 from rows that existed before it. `error` is the wallet's own text: render it as plain text

post.summary: Issue one verified receipt per item once the payment has the configured confirmations (the batch's derived status decides). Idempotent: an issued batch returns its stored receipts without running the issuer again.

200.description: Already issued, or this request lost a concurrent race and recorded nothing (inserted: []): the stored receipts

201.description: Issued now: this request recorded at least one receipt

202.description: Waiting: below the confirmation threshold (pending, not invalid)

post.summary: Lock the draft batch's ZEC/USD rate from the configured source (Kraken's Ticker by default, ZECEIPT_RATE_URL). No body. A re-lock appends a new lock, which becomes current. Refused once the batch has a payment attempt that may have paid; allowed again while its submission is failed_retryable, which proves nothing was paid. On any source failure nothing is locked.

409.description: batch_frozen: the batch has a submission that may have paid; rate_fixed: the batch was made from payables, so its amounts were converted at its lock, which cannot be re-taken; batch_voided: the batch is voided (slice H5c), so nothing was locked

502.description: rate_unavailable: the source gave no usable quote (the extension `reason` is one of network, http, too_large, json, source_error, pair_missing, bad_price, crossed_book); nothing was locked

get.summary: The org's recipients, newest first, each with duplicateOf.

post.summary: Create a recipient (REQ-CON-2). The address must be a unified address of the console's network; a duplicate address is flagged in duplicateOf, not refused.

422.description: recipient_invalid, with every problem (code, field, detail)

get.summary: The recipient's trail, oldest first (slice I4b): created, changed and deleted, written by database triggers in the same transaction as the change. A deleted recipient's trail stays readable by its id. No actor is recorded (one operator, no sign-in).

at.description: ISO 8601 UTC: the record's own time for created (and a recipient's changes), the database clock at the change otherwise

detail.description: created: displayName, network, address (abridged as the pages show it); changed: `fields`, each changed field (displayName, address, network, kycStatus, taxFlag, settlementPref, notes) as {previous, current}; deleted: displayName. `backfilled: true` for events recorded by migration 0022 from rows that existed before it

post.summary: Create a payable (REQ-CON-3): what the org owes one of its recipients, in whole US cents, with a reference that becomes the payment's memo (unique per org).

409.description: reference_taken: another payable of the org has this reference; payableId names it; nothing saved

422.description: payable_invalid, with every problem (code, field, detail): usd_invalid, reference_invalid, recipient_unknown, source_invalid

get.summary: The payable's trail, oldest first (slice I4b): created, changed and deleted, written by database triggers in the same transaction as the change. A deleted payable's trail stays readable by its id. No actor is recorded (one operator, no sign-in).

at.description: ISO 8601 UTC: the record's own time for created (and a recipient's changes), the database clock at the change otherwise

detail.description: created: recipientId, kind, usdCents, reference; changed: `fields`, each changed field (recipientId, kind, usdCents, reference, sourceUrl) as {previous, current}; deleted: reference. `backfilled: true` for events recorded by migration 0022 from rows that existed before it

post.summary: Make a draft batch from payables (slice H5a; REQ-CON-3, REQ-CON-4): quote ZEC/USD, then in one transaction write a line per payable (its recipient's name and address, its reference as memo, zat = floor(usd_cents × 10^8 / (100 × rate))) and record the quote as the batch's only lock. A payable is in at most one batch; the rate is fixed.

422.description: batch_invalid with every problem (code, index, detail): title_invalid, payable_unknown, payable_repeated, payable_taken (already in a batch, named in the detail: as a payables line, or a hand-made line with its id or reference), amount_out_of_range (the conversion is outside 1..2.1e15 zat); checked before the source is asked, and again inside the transaction

502.description: rate_unavailable with reason: the ZEC/USD source did not give a usable quote; nothing was created

post.summary: Void a draft that cannot have paid (slice H5c; as Stripe voids an invoice and BTCPay cancels a payout): allowed while there is no submission or only a failed_retryable one. Final and kept; the batch's memos and payables are released for a new batch.

409.description: batch_frozen: a payment attempt may have sent this batch (a submission in any state but failed_retryable); batch_voided: already voided. Nothing was changed.

code.description: host_not_allowed, cross_site_request, origin_mismatch, unsupported_media_type, body_too_large, bad_request, malformed_json, body_invalid, batch_invalid, batch_not_found, not_ready, internal, payment_rejected, outcome_unknown, submission_in_flight, nonce_conflict, store_busy, wallet_unavailable, custody_external, confirmation_mismatch, preflight_failed, issuance_failed, receipt_unverified, not_ready_for_receipts, batch_frozen, rate_unavailable, rate_not_locked, rate_moved, recipient_invalid, recipient_not_found, payable_invalid, payable_not_found, reference_taken, rate_fixed, batch_voided, not_approved, approval_stale, already_paid_ambiguous

problems.description: batch_invalid (with index), recipient_invalid and payable_invalid (with field): every domain problem

field.description: recipient_invalid and payable_invalid: the body field the problem is about

issues.description: body_invalid: schema issues (path and message; never the submitted value)

thisRequest.description: Submit problems: what THIS request did. sent_nothing = this request broadcast nothing; may_have_sent = the outcome of this request's payment is unknown (outcome_unknown, or an unrecognised failure after the wallet backend was reached). Whether the batch was paid, by this or an earlier request, is only at batchStatus.

batchStatus.description: Submit problems: the batch's status route (RFC 9457's own `status` member is the HTTP status code)

next.description: not_ready_for_receipts: the next action for that state

reason.description: rate_unavailable only: why the source's answer was unusable (a fixed word)

rate.description: rate_moved only: the lock and the execution quote that were compared (REQ-CON-21)

driftBps.description: The move in basis points, floored to 0.01 for display

payableId.description: reference_taken only: the payable that already has this reference

address.description: Unified address for the deployment's network

zat.description: Integer zatoshi as a decimal string (1 ZEC = 100000000 zat); strings because totals can exceed 2^53.

memo.description: 1–512 UTF-8 bytes, unique within the batch

totalZat.description: Integer zatoshi as a decimal string (1 ZEC = 100000000 zat); strings because totals can exceed 2^53.

zat.description: Integer zatoshi as a decimal string (1 ZEC = 100000000 zat); strings because totals can exceed 2^53.

usdCents.description: A line made from a payable (slice H5a): the payable's US cents, converted at the batch's lock; null for a hand-made line

rateLock.description: The current ZEC/USD lock, or null until the batch is locked

rateFixed.description: Made from payables (slice H5a): the amounts were converted at rateLock, which cannot be re-taken (409 rate_fixed)

voided.description: Voided (slice H5c): final; nothing was sent, and its memos and payables are free again. Null while live.

linkability.description: The batch validation report's linkability part (slice H6; REQ-CON-6, spec §9): lines paying an address (the same Orchard receiver) that another batch's receipt already disclosed. Empty when none.

url.description: The shareable receipt link (like Stripe's receipt_url). It contains the output's OCK: a bearer capability. Absent when openError is set.

receipt.description: The signed receipt envelope (no challenge: console receipts are bearer documents). Absent when openError is set.

openError.description: This row's sealed payload did not open (e.g. seal_unknown_kid); the other rows are still returned

RateLock.description: A ZEC/USD quote recorded as a batch's rate lock (slice G1c1; REQ-CON-4, NFR-8). The rate is the bid (BTCPay's choice); ask and last are kept so another reasonable method can be applied consistently. Each lock is a new record: a re-lock appends and becomes current.

seq.description: Position in the batch's quote history

host.description: The host (with any port) the quote was fetched from (slice N1): api.kraken.com for Kraken itself; null for quotes recorded before hosts were. The console names the source only for its own host.

bid.description: USD per ZEC, a plain decimal string exactly as the source sent it

ask.description: USD per ZEC, a plain decimal string exactly as the source sent it

last.description: USD per ZEC, a plain decimal string exactly as the source sent it

rate.description: The rate used to convert: equal to bid

fetchedAt.description: When the source's answer arrived (the console's clock; the ticker carries no timestamp)

Recipient.description: A payee the org pays (slice H1; REQ-CON-2). A live record: batch items copy label and address at creation, so a later change never rewrites what was paid.

address.description: A unified address of the console's network, lowercase

kycStatus.description: Recorded and shown; never blocks a payment (FLOW-1)

settlementPref.description: Recorded preference; the console pays ZEC

duplicateOf.description: Other recipients with the same address: flagged, not blocked (05)

disclosedBy.description: Batches whose receipts already disclosed this address (the same Orchard receiver; slice H6, REQ-CON-6). Empty when none.

address.description: All one case; an all-upper-case address is stored lowercase

usdCents.description: Whole US cents, $0.01 to $999,999.99 (a number, not a string: every allowed value is exact)

reference.description: Becomes the memo exactly as written: plain text, no leading or trailing whitespace, Unicode NFC; unique per org

sourceUrl.description: Optional link to the grant, issue or invoice: https:// or http://, absolute, no user name or password

items.description: A payable of this org (UUIDv7), not already in a batch
